text:
[LSCO.3.9.1] DS resists growing imperative escape hatches.
Where an imperative shape is needed, the base language
already carries it: per-fact supersedure on `after as`
([LRST.2.2]), and activation-bound fact lifetimes as
`scope activation` ([LSCP.3]). A queue is not
provided — use the WorkItem decoupling pattern, or buffer
adapter-side. If those primitives aren't enough, the right
fix is an adapter that exposes the behaviour as a callable
service — not new procedural primitives in DS.
